written.headline: Nvidia employees stunned as board weighs Jensen Huang’s future after affair disclosures
written.summary: Nvidia employees expressed shock and anger after reports that CEO Jensen Huang had a second extramarital affair, prompting the board to consider his future. Shares fell sharply in pre‑market trading and the company has no clear successor.

written.headline: Nvidia board weighs successors for Jensen Huang amid ouster reports
written.summary: Nvidia's board is evaluating replacements for CEO Jensen Huang, considering internal candidates such as CFO Colette Kress and CUDA inventor Ian Buck, as well as external leaders like Arm CEO Rene Haas and Apple chief hardware officer Johny Srouji. The board has hired an outside firm to identify candidates and is meeting to decide on an interim chief.

written.headline: WhatsApp CEO Kunal Shah outlines plans for payments, eSIMs and AI in chats
written.summary: WhatsApp global CEO Kunal Shah said the Meta-owned app will focus on richer communication features, in-chat financial services such as bill payments, loans and eSIM purchases, and AI to manage bookings and appointments. He said the company is working with financial services and telecom partners but did not name them or give a timeline.
